title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 7: Solomon's own house and the bronze and gold work for Yahweh's house.

questions.text: How many years did Solomon spend building his own house?
questions.explanation: Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

questions.text: For whom did Solomon also make a house like the porch?
questions.explanation: He also made a house for Pharaoh's daughter, whom Solomon had taken as wife, like this porch.

questions.text: Hiram, the bronze worker, was the son of a widow from which tribe?
questions.explanation: Hiram was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in bronze.

questions.text: What names were given to the two bronze pillars at the porch of the temple?
questions.explanation: He set up the right pillar and called it Jachin, and the left pillar and called it Boaz.

questions.text: What did the molten sea stand on?
questions.explanation: The sea stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward each direction, with their hindquarters inward.

questions.text: How much did the molten sea hold?
questions.explanation: The sea was a hand width thick, its brim was like the flower of a lily, and it held two thousand baths.

questions.text: What was on the panels between the ledges of the bronze bases?
questions.explanation: On the panels between the ledges of the bases were lions, oxen and cherubim.

questions.text: Where were the bronze vessels cast?
questions.explanation: The king cast them in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.

answers.text: In the plain of the Jordan
In the valley by the brook Kidron

questions.text: Why did Solomon leave the bronze vessels unweighed?
questions.explanation: Solomon left all the vessels unweighed because there were so many; the weight of the bronze could not be determined.

answers.text: There were so many of them
The bronze was a gift from Tyre

questions.text: What did Solomon bring into the treasuries of Yahweh's house when the work was finished?
questions.explanation: Solomon brought in the things David his father had dedicated, the silver, the gold and the vessels, and put them in the treasuries.

answers.text: The things David his father had dedicated
